title: resolveRawDb: removed redundant null check
detail: CodeQL flagged db !== null after if (!db) — truthiness already excludes null. Internal cleanup, no API break.

title: Seed hook: explicit SessionUser typing
detail: Fixed tenant seeding type annotation — prevents implicit any propagation in seed handlers.

title: Seed afterCommit + real tenant rescope
detail: ScheduleAfterCommit now available on HandlerContext — fireEntityPostSave queues after TX commit instead of mid-transaction. DB/notify/hasFeature/_tenantId are correctly rescoped when targeting an entity's tenant.
migration: Only affects custom seed handlers using fireEntityPostSave — now afterCommit-compatible.

title: tenant: seedTenant fires entity postSave hooks (#1463).
detail: tenant: seedTenant fires entity postSave hooks (#1463). `seedTenant` writes through the raw event-store executor, which never fired postSave hooks — self-signup (`provisionSignupAccount` → `signup-confirm`) silently skipped feature-registered entity hooks like tier-engine's auto-default-tier and app-level auto-default-compliance, leaving new tenants without a tier/compliance row. `seedTenant` and `provisionSignupAccount` take a new optional `hooks: { registry, context }` param; passing it fires the same entity-scoped postSave hooks the dispatcher would, without the full dispatch roundtrip. Existing call-sites are unaffected — the param is optional and append-only.
